```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  repo_only <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", repo_path)
  
  # The secret: We use // instead of https:// to force the browser to treat it as a full URL
  img_src <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_only, "/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_only, "/")

  cat('<tr>')
  # We use a pure HTML string here to bypass R's processing
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_src, '" width="250" style="display:block" border="0"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b style="font-size:16px;">', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source Code</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table>')
